newsitem.title: USA: Cusiana crude price to US plummets on weak demand.
newsitem.headline: Cusiana crude price to US plummets on weak demand.

text.p: The spot price for Colombia's sweet Cusiana crude into the U.S. Gulf Coast has plummeted amid weak refiner demand, trade sources said Monday.
An fob cargo for January 31 to February 1 was sold Monday for a steep discount of 60 cents off March West Texas Intermediate, sources said.
The crude last fetched a premium of 10 cents to March WTI for a January 23-24 cargo.
Before the December holidays, the grade was going for a premium of 40 cents.
"This just shows how little demand there is out there," a trader said.

A series of refinery turnarounds, slim downstream margins and an influx of North Sea and West African crudes has clouded the fundamental picture for Cusiana as well as domestic sweet crudes, traders said.
